common.scanFailed: The scan could not be completed. Check permissions and try again.

fda.title: Disk access permission required
fda.body: Cleanish needs “Full Disk Access” to scan every folder. Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access and add this app.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your disk health
dashboard.measureNote: Each folder is measured once and the Explorer reuses the results during this session.
dashboard.measureTitle: See what is taking up space in your home folder
dashboard.partialNote: ≥ marks a partial total: some items could not be read.

smart.title: Smart Scan
smart.subtitle: Analyze apps, caches and possible leftovers; choose what to clean.

apps.title: Applications
apps.subtitle: Space used by apps and their data; protected items are read-only.
apps.quitFirst: The app is running. Quit it before continuing.
apps.quitFailed: The app is still open. Check for a save dialog and try again.
apps.uninstallBlocked: This application is protected or cannot be uninstalled from its location.
apps.selectionNote: Uninstall includes the app and only the data you select. Removing data or containers can remove the app’s settings, sessions and documents.

junk.title: System Junk
junk.subtitle: Caches, logs, trash and development caches
junk.includeDev: Include development caches (npm, pip, Homebrew, Xcode…)
junk.trashNote: Emptying the Trash is permanent and requires permanent deletion to be enabled in Settings
junk.runningNote: Caches and logs of running apps are skipped

large.title: Large Files
large.subtitle: Discover which files take up the most space
large.empty: No files exceed the threshold in this folder.
large.scopeNote: Large files in this folder are shown. Open a subfolder to inspect its files; read-only items cannot be selected.
large.deepNote: Walks the whole folder and its subfolders; large folders take a while. At most {{limit}} files are shown.

explorer.title: Space Explorer
explorer.subtitle: Browse your folders and discover what weighs inside
explorer.lazyNote: Sizes are calculated automatically for folders in this view and reused as you navigate. ≥ means a partial total. Use Refresh to detect external changes.

leftovers.title: Leftovers
leftovers.subtitle: Possible leftovers: review paths before selecting them. They may belong to tools or apps installed elsewhere.
leftovers.empty: No leftovers from uninstalled apps found

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure how the app behaves
settings.permanentDesc: When enabled, you can delete items permanently without going through the Trash and remove items already in the Trash. When disabled, nothing is ever deleted permanently: everything goes to the Trash and can be recovered.
settings.safety1: By default everything goes to the Trash; permanent deletion must be enabled and confirmed every time.
settings.safety2: macOS components, credentials and root folders are protected
settings.safety4: Symbolic links are never followed to delete their targets
settings.saveError: Could not save or load settings.

preview.title: Confirm cleanup
preview.body: The following items will be moved to the Trash:
preview.bodyPermanent: The following items will be PERMANENTLY deleted:
preview.permanentDisabled: Permanent deletion is disabled in Settings; items will go to the Trash.

warning.trashPermanent: Items inside the Trash will be deleted permanently.
warning.trashNeedsPermanent: Items in the Trash can only be removed permanently. Enable “Allow permanent deletion” in Settings to delete them.

preview.bodyMixed: Items already in the Trash will be permanently deleted. The others will be moved to the Trash:
preview.acknowledgePermanent: I understand that the indicated items will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
preview.bodyNone: None of the selected items can be deleted.

toast.cleaned: Completed: {{moved}} moved to Trash; {{freed}} permanently deleted.
toast.failed: Cleanup could not be completed. Refresh and review your selection.
toast.previewFailed: Could not prepare the preview. Please try again.
